messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell doctor about sudden mood or behavior changes"
set: ["tell doctor about sudden mood or behavior changes", "mood or behavior changes", "new or sudden changes in mood or behavior", "unusual changes in mood or behavior", "tell your doctor right away if you have any sudden changes in mood or behavior or thoughts about suicide", "mood or behavior changes are new or worsening symptoms", "mood changes", "mood or behavioral changes", "changes in personality or behavior", "changes in mood or symptoms", "report behavior changes to your doctor", "report mood changes to your doctor", "tell your doctor about blurred vision or other vision changes", "stop taking and call doctor right away if unusual changes in mood or behavior", "behavior changes in children", "inform doctor about any changes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
